description: Compose Multiplatform integration for the Paginator pagination library. Provides idiomatic bindings between Paginator's PrefetchController and LazyListState / LazyGridState / LazyStaggeredGridState — auto-pagination on scroll without manual snapshotFlow wiring. UI structure is left fully to the user; this artifact only feeds scroll signals to the controller. Targets Android, iOS, JVM (Desktop), JS and Wasm (Web).
